title: Acceptance during output-index parsing
statement: For every Boolean value list $v$ and marked-index list $M$, and for every Boolean string $\ell$ and natural number $j$, the evaluator started in its output-index-reading phase at position $j$ accepts on $\ell$ exactly when there is a natural number $r$ such that $\ell$ consists of $r$ true bits followed by a false bit, $j+r<|v|$, and the value of $v$ at index $j+r$ is true.
